name: Between Floors
source:
This visual novel tells us the story of Alon, who was fortunate enough to be transferred to the prestigious school. And that's the guy who's going to find out what was hidden behind this beautiful screen.

[From [url=https://double-edge.itch.io/between-floors]Itch.io[/url]]
